title: driver-turso remote: a storage.notNull field with a literal defaultValue, added to a populated table, is refused remotely and accepted locally (the remote face emits no declared column DEFAULT)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8wf3DSPRevwNnYLcM
Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet · finding class b · reach: named producer (RemoteTransport.syncSchema / syncSchemasBatch on every hosted Turso/libSQL environment)

## What

`packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts` emits no declared column `DEFAULT` for any field, while the local face's `createColumn` (`driver-sql`) emits a literal or `NOW()` `defaultValue` (`applyDeclaredColumnDefault`). So a field declaring both `storage: { notNull: true }` and a literal `defaultValue`, added to a table that already holds a row, is accepted locally (existing rows take the default) and refused on the remote face (`Cannot add a NOT NULL column with default value NULL`), which fails that object's whole sync through both doors.

## Evidence

- `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-remote-not-null.test.ts` case 5, `RECORDED ASYMMETRY: with a literal defaultValue the local face accepts and this face refuses`, pins it today.
- The #37281 dev measured case 5 still holds after PR #37343 (report: #37281 comment 7172805674). PR #37343 deliberately keeps ` NOT NULL` for such a field on the remote face, so the two faces do not fork on the column shape; the remaining gap is the DEFAULT itself.
- The `columnDeclarationSQL` docblock at PR #37343 head states it: "closing it means deciding whether, and from which shared source, this face emits declared defaults".

## Why its own card

It is a DEFAULT question, not a nullability one: closing it means the remote face emitting declared column defaults (a shared source with `driver-sql`'s `emitsDeclaredColumnDefault` / `applyDeclaredColumnDefault`, and the drift differ's reading of remote column defaults), which is wider than #37281's acceptance.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage)

- On the remote face, `syncSchema` and `syncSchemasBatch` give a populated table the same answer as the local face for a `storage.notNull` field with a literal or `NOW()` `defaultValue`.
- `turso-remote-not-null.test.ts` case 5 asserts one outcome for both faces; the recorded-asymmetry note is removed.

Blocked-by: #37281
Dedupe: searched 'turso remote declared column DEFAULT defaultValue' — nearest #36245 (closed, local DEFAULT removal drift), #23847 (closed, remote NOT NULL), #37281 (open, the no-default half); no open card on this path.
